notes: Times include harness conversion, Metal process launch, file I/O and runtime shader compilation. Memory values are MiB; MLX peak is allocator memory and process RSS is a lifetime high-water mark. RUSAGE_CHILDREN ru_maxrss is a cumulative child high-water mark, so its delta can be zero after warmup and is not an individual child's true peak. Judge tracemalloc tracks Python/NumPy allocations. Differences are maximum absolute error divided by the maximum absolute reference value. Large runtime is an unverified estimate; GPU execution was reserved.
